fields.Name: T196 - Admin ERD Filter Panel Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the EntityAdmin dashboard-to-ERD-composite filter-panel toggle plumbing (toggleFilterPanel → erdComposite.onToggleFilterPanel, filterPanelVisible split-area) — distinct from in-diagram search/zoom.

InputDefinition.goal: In MJ Explorer, switch to the Admin application via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo. Open 'Data & Schema' and open the ERD (Entity Relationship Diagram) viewer. Wait for the diagram to render (10-30s possible — wait, don't navigate away). The page header has a 'Filters' button (funnel icon). Note whether the left-hand filter panel is currently shown, then click the 'Filters' button. Success is that clicking the button TOGGLES the left filter panel — it hides if shown, or shows if hidden — and the button reflects an active/inactive state accordingly. Toggle it once more to confirm it flips back. Seeing the panel show/hide in response is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Entity Admin header shows a 'Filters' toggle button and the ERD layout adjusts (left filter panel appears/disappears) when clicked
Toggling again flips the panel back and the button's active state reflects the current visibility
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
